scope: Workspace-only quality audit of the eight story records returned by the local public-story snapshot on 2026-10-12. This is not a production inventory, baseline, or parity claim; production editorial records were not changed.

measurement.bodyWordCount: Whitespace-separated words in story-body headings and paragraphs; summaries, takeaways, and metadata are excluded.
measurement.editorialWordCount: getStoryWordCount(): dek, body paragraphs, bottom line, why it matters, key takeaways, and what changes.
measurement.readTime: Derived with getStoryReadTime() from the complete reader-facing story copy.
measurement.citationCheck: Each listed source has an inline citation in visible story copy, and each cited source resolves in the maintained source registry.
measurement.comparisonNote: All rows describe local workspace records only. They do not state what any published production route contains.

rows.title: India’s AI compute gap is now a measurement problem
rows.evidenceBoundary: Fourteen primary records establish programme claims, dated project allocations and provider/category listings; the newest listing has no explicit as-of date or operational status definitions. Eight independent or market sources add reporting and physical data-centre context. Public evidence does not reconcile GPU status or meter usage.

rows.title: AI’s electricity demand is becoming a product-design constraint
rows.evidenceBoundary: The IEA’s global data-centre forecast and Stanford’s analysis of competition on cost and reliability support a system-level design argument, not per-request energy estimates.

rows.title: AI agents improved on OSWorld; reliability remains the test
rows.evidenceBoundary: Stanford’s OSWorld score and human baseline support a benchmark-specific conclusion, not a production reliability estimate.

rows.title: Preprint links cooperative game choices to familiar action labels
rows.evidenceBoundary: A single, substantially revised arXiv preprint supports the account; no independent replication is included in this source set.

rows.title: ProteoGPT study reports peptide candidates for resistant bacteria
rows.evidenceBoundary: One peer-reviewed primary study reports in-vitro and mouse-model findings; no independent replication is included in this source set.

rows.title: C2PA provenance records do not prove content is true
rows.evidenceBoundary: EU policy and C2PA capabilities are supported by official records; security criticisms come from one attributed arXiv preprint.

rows.title: Mistral Small 4’s active parameter count is not its full footprint
rows.evidenceBoundary: One provider-authored model card supplies specifications; this source set contains no independent performance or hardware-fit measurements.

publicationQualityGate.inlineCitationCoverage: All listed citations resolve to the maintained registry; each listed source appears in reader-facing copy.
publicationQualityGate.withdrawnStoryRelationshipCheck: Public story results exclude withdrawn stories and remove related-story links that do not resolve to a currently public story.
